ui_pathmap_learn_uses_your_quiz_answers_: PathMap Learn uses your quiz answers, learning progress and preferences to tailor your learning. In the local demo, preferences are stored on your device. When live accounts are configured, your email and learning records are held in Supabase.
ui_public_portfolios_recruiter_visibilit: Public portfolios, recruiter visibility and leaderboards are opt-in. We never send email, SMS or WhatsApp reminders without your recorded permission.
ui_you_can_request_an_export_or_deletion: You can request an export or deletion of your account data through settings when signed in. Clearing this site’s browser storage removes local demo data. Sign-in links are handled by Supabase; Google sign-in shares the profile information you approve.
ui_saved_lessons_may_be_cached_on_this_d: Saved lessons may be cached on this device. Avoid saving personal information on a shared device and remove downloads when you finish using it.
ui_external_learning_providers_have_thei: External learning providers have their own privacy policies. Opening a resource takes you to that provider’s website. PathMap does not load videos until you choose to open them.
quiz_choose_hint: Choose the answer that feels most like you. There are no right or wrong answers.
quiz_tailoring_hint: This helps tailor your learning. It does not limit which path you can take.
quiz_question_interest: Which kind of work interests you most?
quiz_question_strength: What feels most natural to you?
quiz_question_language: Which language would you like to learn in?
quiz_question_device: What is your device or data situation?
quiz_question_time: How much time can you learn each week?
quiz_question_goal: What would you like this learning to lead to?
quiz_question_confidence: How are you feeling about starting?
quiz_device_low: I need to keep data use low
quiz_confidence_unsure: Curious, but not sure where to start
quiz_confidence_support: I would like encouragement along the way
quiz_save_error: Your browser could not save this answer. Allow site storage and try again.
quiz_privacy: Answers and the latest 25 attempts stay in this browser. No account or connection is needed once the quiz is loaded.
quiz_no_results_text: Answer ten short questions to see your recommended paths.
quiz_results_heading: There’s a path for what makes you, you.
quiz_results_intro: Here are two directions to explore, based on your answers. You can learn new strengths and change your path at any time.
quiz_strength_description_logic: You enjoy making sense of information and working through problems step by step.
quiz_strength_description_building: You learn by making, experimenting and turning ideas into something useful.
quiz_strength_description_creativity: You enjoy imagining possibilities and expressing ideas through words or design.
quiz_strength_description_people: You enjoy understanding people, sharing ideas and helping others move forward.
quiz_strength_description_detail: You enjoy noticing what others miss and bringing order to work.
quiz_reason_background: Your background offers a starting point: {answer}.
quiz_match_note: These scores compare your answers with each path’s weighted profile. They are guidance, not an ability test or a prediction of success. Interests count most, then strengths, then background.
quiz_first_step_data: Track a few everyday expenses, group them, and look for a pattern. Start with paper or a small spreadsheet.
quiz_first_step_web: Sketch a simple page about yourself. Give it a heading, a short paragraph and a link, then learn how HTML describes each part.
quiz_first_step_cyber: Compare a genuine message with a suspicious one. Look for an unexpected request, a misleading sender or an unusual link.
quiz_first_step_ai: Sort ten familiar objects into groups. Describe the features you used, and see how examples can help a machine learn a classification.
quiz_first_step_design: Choose a familiar phone screen. Sketch a clearer version and ask someone which version is easier to use and why.
quiz_first_step_marketing: Pick a small product and write two headlines for different customers. Ask which message makes the benefit clearest.
quiz_first_step_business: List the costs of a small product or service. Try a price that covers the costs and leaves a modest profit.
quiz_first_step_writing: Explain an everyday idea in five sentences. Rewrite it using shorter words, then ask a reader what they understood.
quiz_first_step_project: Plan a small event or personal task. List the steps, choose what must happen first and give each step a realistic deadline.
quiz_first_step_teaching: Explain one thing you know to a beginner. Use a simple example, ask a question and adjust your explanation to their answer.
known_question: Which path would you like to take?
known_intro: Choose your path, level and learning language. No strengths quiz is needed.
known_ready_intro: You chose this direction. Here is a practical first step based on your selected path.
known_privacy: Your choices and the latest 25 selections stay on this device. Your quiz history is preserved. You can change paths at any time.
learn_intro: Starter courses with reading, practice and a knowledge check.
learn_notes_hint: Write at least 20 characters. Notes save on this device as you type.
learn_required: Write your practice response and choose an answer first.
learn_incorrect: That answer needs another look. Read the lesson and try again.
learn_success: Lesson completed. Your progress is saved.
learn_finished: You completed this starter course! Review your work and keep practising your new skill.
learn_storage: Your progress and practice stay on this device. They do not sync between devices.
learn_save_error: We could not save your work. Check browser storage before leaving.
learn_load_error: Could not load lessons. Reconnect and try again.
learn_scope: These short courses introduce the basics. You can review any lesson at your own pace.
learn_instructions: Read the lesson, do the practice and pass the check to complete it.
learn_offline: Lessons you open are available offline after loading. Open each lesson while connected before studying offline.
eng_intro: Your progress on this device. Complete a practice and its knowledge check to record a learning day. Days follow Lagos time (UTC+1).
eng_week_progress: {days} learning days in the last 7 days. Goal: {goal}.
eng_freeze: One missed day is protected per streak. A protected day adds no points. Two missed days end the streak.
eng_ranking: Ranked by learning days in the last 30 days, then completed lessons and points. Only learners active in the last 7 days who opt in appear.
eng_error: This could not be saved or loaded. Check your connection and try again.
eng_unconfigured: Shared rankings and recruiter access are not connected yet. Your device progress still works.
eng_guest: Sign in to publish your visibility choices and record learning for the shared board.
eng_connected: Connected. Your sharing choices are controlled below.
eng_empty: No ranked learners yet. No sample profiles are shown.
eng_evidence: These records show practice and consistency, not a professional certification or a hiring guarantee. Starting level is self-reported.
eng_verification: Only practices accepted by the server while signed in count for shared rankings. Offline history remains on your device. A lesson earns 100 points once; each learning day earns 25.
eng_consent: Both options start off. Turn either off and save to withdraw it. Public ranking shares your nickname, path and learning totals. Recruiters also see the profile fields below.
eng_public_consent: Show my nickname and learning totals on the public top-10 board.
eng_recruiter_consent: Let approved recruiters see this profile and send me opportunity requests.
eng_local_saved: Saved on this device only. Sign in with a connected account to publish these choices.
eng_invalid: Use a nickname of 2–30 letters, numbers, spaces or simple punctuation.
eng_contact_control: Your email and practice drafts are not shared. You decide whether to accept and what to include in your reply.
eng_recruiter_intro: Find learners who choose to share their practice and commitment, for internships and job opportunities.
eng_approval_detail: A platform administrator must approve your organisation before you can browse learners or send requests.
eng_empty_candidates: No opted-in active learners match these filters.
eng_request_sent: Request sent. The learner can accept or decline in their dashboard.
comm_intro: Find a small group learning your path, share your progress, and ask for guidance.
comm_unconfigured: Shared circles and mentors are not connected yet. You can prepare a question draft on this device.
comm_guest: Sign in to join a circle and send private questions to approved mentors.
comm_connected: Connected. Joining a circle is your choice.
comm_consent: Joining shares your nickname and messages with up to 12 learners matched by path, level and language. It does not enable recruiter or public ranking visibility.
comm_leave_hint: Leaving removes your messages from the board and withdraws your mentor approval. Your private learner conversations remain available.
comm_prompt: What did you learn this week? What is one thing you are stuck on, and what small step will you try next?
comm_rules: Be kind and specific. Share plain text, not passwords, phone numbers or private documents. Use Report for spam, harassment or unsafe content.
comm_response_hint: Replies are not instant. Refresh to check for updates, keep learning while you wait, and ask an approved mentor when you need more guidance.
comm_share: Share a question or a small win
comm_storage_error: Your draft is in this page only; device storage is unavailable. Copy it before leaving.
comm_empty_board: No messages yet. Share a question or introduce what you are learning.
comm_report_hint: Reporting hides the message for you and sends it to the moderation queue. Your report is private.
comm_join_first: Join a connected circle to read and post messages.
comm_mentor_intro: Approved mentors matching your path and learning language can help with questions and next steps. Conversations are private to you and the assigned mentor.
comm_no_mentors: No approved matching mentors are available yet. Keep your question draft and check again later.
comm_draft_hint: This draft saves on your device as you type. It is sent only when you choose a mentor and submit.
comm_guidance_intro: Continue the conversation here. Mentors may propose a check-in time; a learner must confirm it. Sessions take place in this message space.
comm_session_hint: Choose a future time within 90 days using your device’s local time. The learner must confirm.
comm_apply_hint: Join a circle first, then describe your experience. An administrator reviews mentor applications. You cannot approve yourself.
comm_bio_hint: Use 20–500 characters. Mention what you can help learners practise.
comm_invalid: Check your message length, mentor selection or session date, then try again.
comm_saved: Saved. Your conversations are up to date.
show_intro: Share what you are learning, a summary or a project. Encourage your circle with likes and thoughtful comments.
show_disconnected: Join a connected study circle to publish and see colleagues’ work. You can prepare a draft here.
show_photo_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Resized to 960 pixels and stripped of camera metadata.
show_draft_hint: Text drafts save on this device. Pictures stay in this page only. Share only work and pictures you have permission to share.
show_consent: I agree to share this post and picture with my circle. This does not publish to recruiters or the public.
show_empty: No shared work here yet. Keep practising and share a small step.
show_invalid: Check the title, summary, HTTPS link and picture description.
show_photo_error: Choose a readable JPEG, PNG or WebP under 5 MB. Try a smaller picture.
learn_focused: Continue the course for your assessed or chosen path. Your saved work and next lesson stay together.
learn_assess_first: Complete your path assessment first so we can show your course.
learn_matched_only: This course belongs to another path. Continue your matched course below.
